I know that this wiki is pretty lax with documentation, but I believe that it is essential if we would like to have accurate, comprehensive articles. Properly documenting articles takes time, but it helps with issues that may be confusing or in dispute. Documenting your articles also helps provide a starting point for another user who wishes to add to the article or create an article for a related topic or a "wanted page.[[User:Joedmd|Joedmd]] 16:57, February 4, 2011 (UTC)
